entries.title: Sending a change back no longer fails the fix pushed after the pause
entries.body: When your project's batch pauses and someone sends one change back, the queue now fails only the version the batch ran. If that change was pushed again with a fix in the meantime, the queue writes nothing on the fix and says so on the pause's issue, so the fix goes in a later batch instead of being sent back by mistake. Your first mate offers a project's queue the update.
entries.noPicture: The change is in what a project's queue writes on a change and its pause issue where the project lives; no screen in the app looks different.
